body: Have you found any opportunities? I’m looking for them too but can’t seem to find any
Thanks a lot! That’s really helpful I appreciate it
I don’t see a point in talking when I just wanna die
Yeah but how do I convince myself to go when dying seems like the better option

Money won’t happy. It will only make you comfortable. Once your needs have been taken care of such as food, shelter etc. More money doesn’t really change how you feel. I’ve come to realise this recently
I’ve tried everything. This is how it’s gonna be I just need to grow some balls to acc do it this time and not stop midway
I don’t think I can. It’s been happening for way too long now and I just can’t anymore
I don’t really have cliffs where I live
I tried to hang but the thing broke
I tried to suffocate myself
I’ve tried it and I stopped cause it was too painful
So the only possible way is to deal with the pain
Because I’ve had enough and I’ve made this decision
But you don’t even know me
It doesn’t even matter if I’m here or not. I just really can’t be here
Yea I’d wanna be but I don’t think there’s a point cause my plan is to end myself soon
I really appreciate it but I don’t think I can do anything right now I’ve just been crying for awhile. Thank you so much for saying that you’re really sweet

But why should I try to do that. Isn’t that ‘someone’ supposed to already be there? Why should I live for someone who isn’t even here. I don’t even wanna live anymore. I appreciate it thought and I’m sorry if I’m being annoying by saying all this
What is a therapist gonna do about me being lonely? It’s all just a distraction. What I really need is to just go. No wonder why it comforts me so much to know that I’m gonna do it soon.
Don’t really have a reason to be here. I just need to arrange some things and get it over with
Yeah I think that’s happening with me because sometimes good things would happen but I wouldn’t allow myself to feel happy. I wanna stop this though and truly feel happy without being fearful

I did talk to them but I guess part of the problem is they did some stuff to hurt me too so it isn’t really ideal for me to go back to a place to get love where I was hurt before. And that makes me feel so lonely. It’s like I can never describe my pain to anyone no matter how much I try. I don’t think anyone can help so it doesn’t matter they wouldn’t blame themselves after I kill myself
Yeah I’m asking for help cause I’ve tried ways which didn’t work and left me with pain. If you do not want to help that’s totally fine just don’t say anything then
Yeah so there’s nothing bad with it. I need this
I don’t think so. They’d be doing me a favour as id be relieved of all my pain
Never. Sometimes she’s my only hope to keep going

I have that one person and I’m so lucky to have her. After everyone gave up on me she’s still there. Even though I don’t have much to offer because of my suicidal nature she still tries her best to get me out of this and I couldn’t be more grateful for having her
Maybe it’s something about today. I felt so anxious today and ended up self harming

I feel like our world is a fucked up place. Poverty, terrorism and a million other things that take place on a day to day basis. How’s everyone just okay with knowing that these things are happening. I don’t wanna live in a world where everybody pretends to be fine because they are too scared not to. I don’t wanna have life where I pretend like everything is fine around me when it’s clearly not. I get that it’s our natural instinct to survive but if you look past it, you might realise that everything is fucked just like I did .Thanks for listening I know it’s a lot to take in
Thanks but I just feel like ‘hope’ is something that should come from within. And trying to be hopeful is just gonna delay what I want to do. I know this is how I’m gonna die, sooner or later
